'''Juuho''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] [[Smuggler/Legends|Smuggler]] who served as trainer onboard the [[Carrick Station]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]].
